english.title: Obstruct immigration officer exercising right of entry to licensed premises to investigate immigration offences
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed an immigration officer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), exercising a right of entry into premises, namely **(SPECIFY THE PREMISES..) which

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

had reason to believe were being used for a licensable activity, to ascertain whether an offence under any of the Immigration Acts was being committed in connection with the carrying on of the activity
english.legislation: Contrary to section 179(1A), (4) and (5) of the Licensing Act 2003
